snippet.title: Castle of Heart: Retold - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Embark on a challenging quest to defeat the evil sorcerer as a cursed warrior in this dark-fantasy action platformer inspired by the Slavic mythology. Vanquish magical creatures, overcome lethal traps, and master demanding action sequences—before the curse will turn your stone body into dust. 

MAIN FEATURES :
● A unique main character: a knight turned into stone who needs to keep fighting to avoid disintegrating
● 20 completely different levels in 4 beautiful environments loosely inspired by real-life locations
● Roughly 50 types of both short- and long-range weapons, allowing each gamer to find their own, individual combat style
● At least 7 hours of addictive, exciting gameplay
● Epic boss fights at the end of every location
● Breathtaking graphic design
● Numerous power-ups that enrich the gameplay

MAIN CHANGES :
● improved graphics, realistic shadows and lightning, improved performance
● New and refreshed environment
● New visual effects
● New models and assets
● New animations
● Design changes based on users’ feedback from original
==================================================
